classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught digit shifts in labelled place-value tables, choosing direction and distance and inserting placeholder zeros where needed.

content.prompt: Use the place value tables to multiply or divide these numbers.

spec.description: Eight aligned place-value columns, angled labels and two rows of blank rounded digit boxes; fixed decimal points between Ones and Tenths.
spec.mathematics: Record 5.718 in the upper row and its product with 10 in the lower row.
spec.answerVisibility: All sixteen digit boxes are blank.

answer.worked:
Move the digits one place value to the left. The decimal point stays fixed.
$$\begin{align*}5.718\times10&=57.18\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed place-value rows with each digit moving one column left.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed digits and movement arrows appear only in the solution.
